Overview

Rakvere is a city in Lääne-Viru County with a population of 15,000. A historic town in northern Estonia, known for the Rakvere Castle, the unique Tarvas bull sculpture, and a vibrant cultural and theater scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
